title: Oracle Concerning Cush

questions.question: Ah, land of whirring wings that is beyond the rivers of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 18:1 (ESV): "Ah, land of whirring wings that is beyond the rivers of Cush,"

questions.question: Which sends ambassadors by the sea, in vessels of what on the waters?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 18:2 (ESV): "in vessels of papyrus on the waters!"

questions.question: Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 18:2 (ESV): "to a nation tall and smooth,"

questions.question: To a people feared near and far, a nation mighty and what?
Whose land the rivers do what?
All you inhabitants of the world, you who dwell on the earth, when a signal is raised on the mountains, do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 18:3 (ESV): "when a signal is raised on the mountains, look!"

questions.question: And when a trumpet is blown, do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 18:3 (ESV): "and when a trumpet is blown, hear!"

questions.question: I will quietly look from my dwelling like clear heat in what?
Like a cloud of dew in the heat of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 18:4 (ESV): "like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest."

questions.question: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he cuts off the shoots with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 18:5 (ESV): "he cuts off the shoots with pruning hooks,"

questions.question: And the spreading branches he lops off and does what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 18:5 (ESV): "and the spreading branches he lops off and clears away."

questions.question: They shall all of them be left to the birds of prey of the mountains and to the beasts of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 18:6 (ESV): "and to the beasts of the earth."

questions.question: And the birds of prey will summer on them, and all the beasts of the earth will do what on them?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 18:6 (ESV): "and all the beasts of the earth will winter on them."

questions.question: At that time tribute will be brought to the LORD of hosts from a people tall and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 18:7 (ESV): "from a people tall and smooth,"

questions.question: To the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, to Mount what?

key_verse_text: At that time tribute will be brought to the LORD of hosts from a people tall and smooth... to the mount of the daughter of Zion.
